title: simple-git argument parser misses the VISUAL editor execution path
summary: The parser omits VISUAL from unsafe-editor detection. A consumer forwarding attacker-controlled environment values can execute an attacker-selected editor during interactive Git operations.

severity.rationale: Code execution requires a Git operation opening an editor and control over its environment. Such job and agent input flows can defeat the default unsafe-operation guard.

exposure: Requires an executable attacker-selected editor, suitable TERM and no higher-priority editor override. Consumers without untrusted environment forwarding are not exposed through this path.

remediation.details: Upgrade the parser to 2.0.1. Verify the resolved dependency in applications using simple-git.
remediation.risk: Low. Test dependent workflows after updating.

verification: Confirm the installed version or revision and exercise the affected workflow with trusted inputs.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted for independent review.
